methodology:
Camellia plc is a diversified UK plc holding company. The agriculture segment manages ~50,000 hectares (~124K acres) across 3 continents — primarily tea (Africa, South Asia), with newer macadamia + avocado positions and some arable/livestock. Camellia is unique in the comp set for being a multi-segment conglomerate; the agriculture-only carve-out matters for valuation but isn't cleanly broken out in their public reports.

FY24 was a transitional year with the company restoring dividends after a tough post-Covid period. Tea prices recovered in India during 2024; macadamia and avocado prices showed recovery signs.

All figures in this table are GBP. Camellia's 2024 group revenue was ~£275M with the agriculture share in the mid-£100Ms. Land book of ~£200M is rough — refining the agriculture-only carve-out from group total Net PP&E would tighten it materially.
